integrity: Mathematical derivation and ordinary symbolic/numerical reproducibility checks; no independent audit, publication priority or physical experimental validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Equilibrium centered Gaussian refreshing and matching OU fluctuation-dissipation noise, positive gamma and r; no statements for position resetting or nonlinear coupled dynamics.
Limiting fourth-cumulant rate and scaled asymptotic kurtosis are distinct observables; no finite-time optimality assertion.
Close 2024 velocity-resetting general theory was available in abstract but not in primary full text, so residual mathematical-priority risk remains.
scientific_scope: Stationary one-dimensional OU velocity with independent Poisson Maxwellian velocity-only refresh; unbounded integrated position; exact second- and fourth-order lag laws, positive finite-time displacement cumulant, asymptotic cumulant and distinct rate optima.
title: Hidden non-Gaussian transport and distinct fourth-cumulant optima under Maxwellian velocity refresh
